hooks.name: Workout metrics sanity check
hooks.description: Guards against the calorie/distance over-counting bugs of the owner's earlier app.

action.prompt: A workout file was saved. Re-check it against .kiro/steering/workout-metrics.md: accumulation only in the 1 Hz tick with real elapsed time (max 2 s), nothing accumulated in BLE callbacks, 5 s cadence staleness, machine totals added only as DeviceCounter increments, the official new formula divided by 3600, 0 kcal at 0 rpm, and the 20 kcal/min cap. Report any violation and fix it.
